settings.heading: The four grades of chocolate
settings.intro: The front of the bag rarely tells you which one you bought. From most processed to least.

settings.title: Cocoa powder
settings.text:
Most of the cacao butter pressed out
Often treated with alkali to darken it
Sugar or milk often added

settings.title: Cacao powder and nibs
settings.text:
Nothing added
Powder has most of the butter removed
Nibs are crushed whole beans

settings.title: Organic cacao
settings.text:
Grown without synthetic pesticides
Blended from many farms
Made in factories

settings.title: Ceremonial grade
settings.text:
Whole bean, butter left in
One origin, never hybridized
Fermented, dried, roasted, and ground by hand
Nothing added

settings.heading: Isn't this just fancy hot chocolate?
settings.row_content: No. Ceremonial grade cacao is single origin and made by hand, with nothing added. It tastes richer and a little bitter, and it's made to be sipped slowly.

settings.heading: Can it replace my coffee?
settings.row_content: It's not meant to. Cacao has theobromine and a little caffeine, and many people say it feels different from coffee. Most enjoy it as its own ritual.

settings.heading: How much should I use?
settings.row_content: Start with ½ oz. Most people settle around 1 oz for a daily cup. More isn't better.

settings.heading: Is cacao safe for everyone?
settings.row_content: Cacao is a food, but it has natural stimulants. If you're pregnant or nursing, have a heart condition, or take medications, please check with your own provider first.

settings.heading: There's a white film on my block. Is it bad?
settings.row_content: No. That's bloom, the cacao's own fat rising to the surface. It's still good.

settings.heading: How fast do you ship?
settings.row_content: Orders ship from Omaha in 1 to 2 business days.

settings.heading: Do you ship in summer?
settings.row_content: Yes. On hot weeks, orders go out in insulated packaging.

settings.heading: Can I return my cacao?
settings.row_content: Opened blocks can't be returned because cacao is a food. If anything arrives damaged, email us and we'll make it right.

settings.heading: Do I need experience to come to a gathering?
settings.row_content: No. Most people at a gathering are trying cacao for the first time.

settings.heading: What does membership include?
settings.row_content: One gathering a month, a members-only gathering each season, 20% off extras, and first access to tickets and to the club when it opens.
